trailhead.label: the boat landing and large car park at the roundabout on the east shore, the board’s start

waypoints.label: Drinking water on the east shore

cautions: About 120 m on the Stockenboier Straße (L32) by the roundabout at the start: keep your dog close.
Footways and the boardwalk are shared with cyclists.
The east shore is busy with bathers in summer: keep your dog close by the beaches.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
